title: Level 1: The language of a single script

tests.name: a01_driver
tests.title: Test primary aspect structure and single line comments

tests.name: a02_comments
tests.title: Every comment form of the language, then a negative end

tests.name: a03_print
tests.title: print writes a string and a new line; no import is needed

tests.name: a04_shebang_error
tests.title: a file has no #! line: Eve has no free scripts, every program is an aspect

tests.name: a05_print_write
tests.title: print adds a new line and separates its arguments with sep, write adds nothing; a list is one argument

tests.name: a06_new_set_let
tests.title: new creates variables, set creates constants, let changes a value

tests.name: a07_arithmetic
tests.title: numeric operators and their precedence

tests.name: a08_logic
tests.title: relation and logical operators, conditional statement and expression

tests.name: a09_literals
tests.title: literals of the primitive types

tests.name: a10_strings
tests.title: strings are immutable UTF-8 text

tests.name: a11_interpolation
tests.title: placeholders {name} and {name % format}: a name, a literal or a simple expression, written by its type; \{ \} are literal braces; {U+H} Unicode (formats are a draft)

tests.name: a12_if
tests.title: if, else if, else and the conditional statement

tests.name: a13_while
tests.title: while loop with a header, break and else; `then` was removed, the code goes after `done;`

tests.name: a14_for
tests.title: for loop over ranges and collections

tests.name: a15_match
tests.title: match with values, lists of values, ranges, other, one and all

tests.name: a16_ordinal
tests.title: an Ordinal is a set of named integer values; the first value is 1 unless one is given

tests.name: a17_list
tests.title: list: literal, index, append, remove, capture, delete, builder, deconstruct

tests.name: a18_array
tests.title: array: literal, index, slice, view and clone, bulk assignment, builder

tests.name: a19_matrix
tests.title: matrix: two indexes, last index, absolute index, [*] selects a dimension

tests.name: a20_dataset
tests.title: DataSet: sorted unique values, union, intersection, difference

tests.name: a21_datamap
tests.title: DataMap: a sorted map of key:value pairs; quoted or numeric keys

tests.name: a22_object
tests.title: Object: unquoted keys make an object, quoted or numeric keys make a DataMap

tests.name: a23_clone_view
tests.title: := shares a collection or an object,:: makes a deep copy, native values are always copied

tests.name: a27_text_literal
tests.title: a text literal is raw and keeps the line breaks; the indentation of the closing quotes is removed

tests.name: a28_regex
tests.title: regular expressions: =~ matches, not (...) negates; a string that starts with / is a regex literal and keeps its backslashes

tests.name: a29_expect_fail
tests.title: a failed expect ends the process with exit code 2

tests.name: a30_over
tests.title: over ends the process it is in with exit code 0

tests.name: a31_recover
tests.title: an error jumps to recover; reaching the end of recover handles the error

tests.name: a32_finalize
tests.title: finalize runs after the process ends normally, and after recover

tests.name: a33_over_finalize
tests.title: over skips recover but runs finalize: a clean exit never skips cleanup

tests.name: a34_jobs
tests.title: jobs: retry runs a failed job again, resume goes on after it

tests.name: a35_index_error
tests.title: index 0 is an error: indexes start at 1

tests.name: a36_map_key_error
tests.title: += on a missing key of a map raises an error

tests.name: a37_division_error
tests.title: a division by zero raises an error, also for Real: no infinity, no NaN

tests.name: a38_matrix_index
tests.title: matrix and tensor indexes: [x, y] is the same as [x][y]; a range selects a part

tests.name: a39_repeat
tests.title: loop tested at the end: loop … do … repeat [while c]; and skip

tests.name: a43_let_creates_name
tests.title: let changes names and creates the ones that are missing, by type inference

tests.name: a44_bare_assignment
tests.title: a change without let is a syntax error

tests.name: a45_redeclare
tests.title: redeclaring a name in the same scope is an error

tests.name: a46_light_assignment
tests.title: = is the light assignment of a declaration; it never changes a variable

tests.name: a47_string_plus_number
tests.title: + between a string and a number is a type error; <+ converts the number

tests.name: a48_single_quote_text
tests.title: a rune holds one code point; 'one' is a lexical error

tests.name: a49_stop_in_job
tests.title: stop ends a job without error; the process goes on with the next statement

tests.name: a50_exit
tests.title: exit ends the process without error and runs finalize

tests.name: a51_unhandled_error
tests.title: an error without recover ends the process with the exit code 4, after finalize

tests.name: a52_assert
tests.title: a failed assert is an error with code 3: the process stops when it is not recovered

tests.name: a53_abort
tests.title: abort in recover ends the process, runs finalize and passes the error on

tests.name: a54_panic
tests.title: panic ends the whole application at once with code 1, without finalize

tests.name: a57_conversion
tests.title: explicit conversions do what the developer asked: floor, ceiling, round, parse (from demo/explicit_coercion.eve and demo/string_to_number.eve)

tests.name: a58_rune_range
tests.title: a range of runes: ('a'..'c') visits the code points in order (from demo/symbol_range.eve)

tests.name: a59_optional_null
tests.title: a variable without a value has the zero value of its type, never null; an optional type T? may hold null (from demo/null_strings.eve)

tests.name: a60_process_args
tests.title: the process receives the command-line arguments; a vararg collects them (from demo/method_call.eve and demo/test_args.eve)

tests.name: a62_multi_line
tests.title: a statement ends with; so an expression or a literal may span several lines (from demo/multi_line.eve)

tests.name: a63_range_domain
tests.title: a range is a domain of values: limits included or excluded, open ends, a step that sets the precision (from demo/domain_demo.eve and demo/numeric_range.eve)

tests.name: a66_bad_placeholder
tests.title: in a string every unescaped brace opens a placeholder {name}; a literal brace is \{ or \}

tests.name: a68_undefined_name
tests.title: an undefined name is a compile error: the script does not start

tests.name: a75_raise_code
tests.title: raise "text" creates an error with code 4 and that message

tests.name: a76_overflow
tests.title: integer overflow is an error with its own code, 13

tests.name: a77_system_variable
tests.title: a primary aspect can set a system variable and define its own $name

tests.name: a78_digit_separator
tests.title: the digit separator _ is not accepted in a number: a lexical error

tests.name: a80_let_capture_loop
tests.title: in a loop a capture creates its name once: the next turns assign it, they do not create it again

tests.name: a81_let_undeclared
tests.title: let creates a missing name only in a capture: let y:= 5 with no y is an error

tests.name: a82_list_ends
tests.title: list modifiers: <+ appends at the end, +> puts in front; the list stays after +> and before <+

tests.name: a83_bulk_scalar
tests.title: collection op scalar: the operator applies to every element

tests.name: a84_bulk_string_error
tests.title: a bulk operation never builds strings: a string element or scalar is an error

tests.name: a85_then_removed
tests.title: `then` no longer exists in match and loops: the code goes after `done;` (negative test)

tests.name: a86_string_slice
tests.title: a string takes a range as index: s[a..b] is the substring of runes a to b, a copy (expressions.md)

tests.name: a87_string_functions
tests.title: string functions: trim, upper, lower, starts_with, ends_with, contains, find, replace (strings.md, G-7)

tests.name: a88_datamap_methods
tests.title: DataMap methods: has, get, keys, values, delete (G-5)

tests.name: a89_exit_code
tests.title: over <code>; ends the process with the exit code, finalize still runs (G-2)

tests.name: a90_exit_code_range
tests.title: an exit code from 1 to 5 belongs to the machine: a run-time error with code 4 (G-2)

tests.name: a91_method_as_name
tests.title: method is a contextual word: a keyword where a declaration is expected, a name everywhere else (G-6)

tests.name: a92_loops_and_calls
tests.title: loops, calls and assignments that every engine must treat alike: break, skip, for with else, short circuit on a variable, compound assignment on a list, recursion

tests.name: a93_os_pwd
tests.title: $OS_PWD is the working folder of the program, read-only (CMD-05)

tests.name: a94_env_variable
tests.title: $NAME is an operating system environment variable, a String

tests.name: a95_error_warning
tests.title: error(text) and warning(text) write a line on the standard error and go on

tests.name: a96_read_line
tests.title: read(prompt) reads a line from the standard input and gives it as a String; at the end of the input it gives null

tests.name: a97_eve_variables
tests.title: the project variables $EVE_HOME, $EVE_LIB, $EVE_LIB_PATH, $EVE_CORE_DB and $EVE_OUT are Strings with the defaults of the table

tests.name: a98_script_params
tests.title: the arguments after the script and -p name=value become the parameters of process main, converted to their types

tests.name: a99_script_help
tests.title: eve script.eve -h prints the help made from the ** @param comments and the parameters of process main; the script does not run

tests.name: a100_script_param_missing
tests.title: a parameter of process main without a default and without a value is a usage error: exit 64, the help is printed

tests.name: a101_scopes
tests.title: where a name lives: the aspect (hoisted, shared with its functions), a process, a loop (one scope for the header and all the cycles), an if (no scope)

tests.name: a102_scope_hidden_local
tests.title: a function does not see the variables of a process, and the variable of a loop is gone after done: both are compile errors

tests.name: a103_scope_loop_variable
tests.title: the control variable of a for loop and the variables of its body are gone after done: using them is a compile error

tests.name: a104_scope_loop_redeclare
tests.title: a loop has one scope for the header and all its cycles: a new written in the body is run again at the second cycle and fails, a name used by all cycles is declared before the loop

tests.name: a105_scope_shadow_in_loop
tests.title: a name that exists outside a loop is shadowed by a new in the body at the first cycle; the second cycle fails because the loop scope already has the name

tests.name: a106_list_functions
tests.title: list functions: sort, reverse, sum, min, max, contains, index_of, unique, take, drop, zip, map, filter, reduce, any, all (lists.md)

tests.name: a107_list_errors
tests.title: list functions with a wrong argument or a wrong element are the error $err_argument (17); each case is caught by a function with a recover region

tests.name: a108_map_functions
tests.title: map functions: merge and invert give a new map and never change the receiver (maps.md)

tests.name: a109_string_more
tests.title: string functions of the core library: reverse, repeat, pad_start, pad_end, lines, upper and lower beyond ASCII (strings.md)

tests.name: a110_math_basic
tests.title: math library: basic, explog, numtheory, and the one module math (math.md)

tests.name: a111_math_trig
tests.title: math library: trigonometry (math.md)

tests.name: a112_math_constants
tests.title: math library: constants exported with set (math.md)

tests.name: a113_math_linear
tests.title: math library: vectors and matrices (math.md)

tests.name: a114_math_random
tests.title: math library: random generator, seeded and not seeded (math.md)

tests.name: a115_math_random_unseeded
tests.title: math library: an unseeded generator gives values of known type, written as {Type} in the expected output (math.md)
